title: Corticosteroids and Hemoglobin A1C Levels in Diabetic Patients With COPD Exacerbation
brief_summary: Corticosteroid treatment in diabetic patients admitted for COPD exacerbation are expected to significantly increase hemoglobin A1C levels
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Diabetic patients with COPD exacerbation

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients treated with steroids during the previous 3 months
study_population: Diabetic patients with COPD ecaxerbation who are admitted to the hospital
